Rae: Quick thought  paper-lantern potluck lunch Friday at 12:30? Tiny decorations, BYO dish or snack, 20-min hang. :lantern:
Ben: Love it. I'll bring a savory tray. Can we keep strong scents to a minimum? Some folks get sensitive.
Sana: I'll bring vegetarian dumplings (no peanuts). Pls label ingredients.
Facilities: FYI we can hang 6 small battery lanterns but nothing taped to the ceiling. We'll help with setup at 12:15.
Ollie: Remote folks can drop a photo or recipe in the thread and we'll pin a collage. :camera_with_flash:
Rae: Quick poll  react with :plate_with_cutlery: if attending in person, :house: if remote snack/photo only, :x: if not.
Ben: Also consent check for photos: thumbs-up if you allow montage in #random. Respect opt-outs.
Sana: thumbs up from me. I'll clearly label my tray GF/DF.
RemindBot: Reminder scheduled: Friday 12:15  Paper Lantern Potluck setup.
Rae: Thanks everyone  short, cozy, inclusive. We'll keep it tidy and under 30 mins. :sparkles:
